answer_2.quote: We report per-class as well as macro average precision, recall and F1 score.

answer_4.quote: We ask crowd‑workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to assess their correctness. Workers are asked to rate the validity of each answer on a 5‑point Likert scale (1 to 5).
